offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures safety products that protect workers and facilities, including self-contained breathing apparatus, gas detection instruments, fixed gas and flame detection systems, head protection, fall protection and firefighter protective gear. Sells to industrial companies, fire services, military and government agencies through distributors and direct sales.

primary_products.value: self-contained breathing apparatus; portable and fixed gas detectors; flame detectors; firefighter helmets and protective clothing; fall protection equipment; industrial head protection

primary_services.value: equipment servicing and calibration; connected safety software; training

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial, construction, oil and gas, utilities and mining companies; B2G: fire departments, emergency responders, military and public safety agencies

end_markets.value: fire service; oil and gas; construction; utilities; chemicals; mining; manufacturing; military

revenue_model.value: product sales: safety equipment, detectors, breathing apparatus and protective gear; service fees: calibration, maintenance, repair and connected software services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds safety equipment from purchased components, sold to industrial users, fire services and distributors

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: breathing apparatus, gas detection, fire service gear, fall protection and head protection

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: safety equipment distributors serving industrial customers; direct sales: fire departments, government agencies and large industrial accounts; online: e-commerce orders and web store

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: safety equipment certification such as NIOSH, NFPA, ATEX and OSHA-related standards
